questions.question_text: Work out 7/12 - 1/3. Give your answer in its lowest terms.
Change 12 metres per second into kilometres per hour.
Write 0.000048 in standard form.
Work out (2 x 10^8) x (6 x 10^7), giving your answer in standard form.
The price of a computer is reduced by 5%. The actual reduction is $17. Find the original price of the computer.
Simplify \sqrt{75} - \sqrt{27}.
Find the value of v when u = 12, a = -2 and t = 5, given v = u + at.
Rearrange the formula v = u + at to make a the subject.
Work out the length of AC in the given right-angled triangle where AB = 17 cm and BC = 15 cm.
Find the median journey time from the cumulative frequency curve.
Find the number of students with a journey time of more than 20 minutes from the cumulative frequency curve.
Find the value of (0.2)^3.
Find the value of (1/2)^(-1).
Find the value of 64^(2/3).
Find the value of \log_9 3.
A, B, C and D lie on a circle, centre O. Find the value of x and the value of y.
The diagram shows the graph of y = |px + q|. Find the value of p and the value of q.
Find n(P \cup Q)'.
Shade the region P \cap Q'.
A is the point (-4, 4) and B is the point (4, 10). Find the equation of the perpendicular bisector of AB.
y varies inversely as \sqrt{x}. When x = 9, y = 3. Find y in terms of x.
Find the value of y when x = 81.
The graph of y = a \cos(bx)^{\circ} has a maximum point at (360, 3) and a minimum point at (450, -3). Find the value of a and the value of b.
